strategy.text: Add a naming layer on the generic registry model. Do not rewrite the generic machine or its forty-one statements.

model-then-simulator.text: The Lean naming layer is the authority. The simulator is derived from it. Naming fixtures are first-class fields, not a packed encoding.

topology-and-budget.text: One owner slice, glm commit owner, sol auditor, at most two candidates and two auditor launches, ten executions.

file-fence.text: The commit owner may write naming modules, the naming simulator, and the naming docs page. Four documentation files and release metadata are reserved or forbidden.

live-preview.text: The existing preview job binds candidate.txt to the pull-request head. A localhost URL is not the preview.
